notes.note: No screen: COPAUA0C issues no SEND/RECEIVE MAP. It retrieves MQ trigger data, processes request messages in a loop and returns without a TRANSID, so the transaction is not pseudo-conversational.

Screen flow of COPAUS0C: first entry (EIBCALEN = 0, or COMMAREA not yet in re-enter state) sends list map COPAU0A; on re-entry it receives COPAU0A and acts on the AID key - Enter re-sends the list or, when a row is selected with 'S', XCTLs to COPAUS1C (detail map COPAU1A); PF7/PF8 page the list; PF3 XCTLs to COMEN01C (module CARDDEMO, not in this scan). Which row is selected is run-time data.

Screen flow of COPAUS1C: entered with a COMMAREA it reads the selected authorization and sends detail map COPAU1A; on re-entry it receives COPAU1A - Enter and PF8 re-send the detail map (PF8 after reading the next authorization), PF5 links to COPAUS2C and re-sends it, PF3 XCTLs back to COPAUS0C (list map COPAU0A). Entered with no COMMAREA it XCTLs straight to COPAUS0C.
